description.zh: 先问大豆进口，再追问出口，查看两个方向的图表和金额。
description.en: An import question followed by an export question, with separate charts and figures.

limitations.zh: 模型选择查询工具，程序计算金额与摘要。以下保留当时的问答和报告。
limitations.en: The model selected query tools; the program calculated figures and summaries. The saved exchange and reports are shown below.

title.en: Soybean oil is not raw soybeans

description.zh: 按“豆油”查找对应商品，查看十二个月的进口变化。
description.en: Look up soybean oil by name and view twelve months of import values.

limitations.zh: 该案例查询豆油（1507），不是原料大豆（1201）。
limitations.en: This case queries soybean oil (1507), not raw soybeans (1201).

title.zh: 钨和光伏材料：政策与进口

description.zh: 五类商品分别展示公告背景、进口金额和中国来源份额。
description.en: An archived notice alongside import values and China-origin shares for five product codes.

limitations.zh: 这是一份资料编辑报告。公告中的附加税率与现行全部税率不同；图表展示进口金额，不计算政策效果。
limitations.en: An edited report. The notice gives additional duties, not current total duties; the charts show import values rather than policy effects.

title.en: The requested month is not available

description.zh: 所问月份未收录，说明缺口而不是改查另一月份。
description.en: Explain a missing month rather than substitute another one.

limitations.zh: 提问日期为2026-09-29。模型尝试改查7月，被程序拦截；本次没有生成报告。
limitations.en: The question was asked on 29 September 2026. The model tried July instead; the program blocked that request and no report was generated.
